jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.jd_full:
What is saas.group?

The role is for a future CEO position at saas.group, tied to an upcoming acquisition in the HR tech and workforce management space. We are continuously acquiring new businesses and are building a strong talent pool of ambitious leaders who want to step into CEO roles within our portfolio. If you see yourself leading a SaaS business with us in the future, we'd love to connect.

At saas.group, we partner with ambitious leaders to transform great SaaS products into category leaders. Founded in 2017, we've built a global powerhouse of B2B SaaS companies by acquiring and scaling high-potential ventures. As a CEO within our group, you'll focus on what you do best — driving growth, building high-performing teams, and shaping product strategy — while we take the weight of administration, finance, and back-office complexity off your shoulders. With the backing of a fully remote team of 380+ colleagues across 50+ countries, you'll run your brand with the autonomy of a founder and the support of an experienced network that sets you up for long-term success.

We grow 23 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, and gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don't forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up to date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

We are looking for a CEO to lead one or more of our HR tech / workforce management SaaS brands into their next stage of growth and scale, with the potential to grow this into a multi-brand roll-up under one leader over time. As CEO, you will own the brand's P&L, strategy, growth, culture, and overall performance, driving both short-term execution and long-term strategic direction. You will work closely with our leadership team, board, and the broader saas.group community to deliver impact across go-to-market, product, operations, and finance. This role is an opportunity to shape the future of a small, highly profitable SaaS business (or cluster of businesses) within a high-growth portfolio, while having the backing, network, and resources of saas.group.

These are product-led, self-serve B2B SaaS businesses serving the German market first, with room to internationalize over time. We're looking for a strong product-led-growth operator and general manager: someone who can grow revenue and product and manage PnL.

Your responsibilities

  • Own growth for a product-led (PLG) SaaS business: sharpen the product, drive acquisition and activation, and build a scalable go-to-market engine: marketing and product are the two competencies that matter most here
  • Drive operational excellence: build budgets, track KPIs, optimize ROI, and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and scalability.
  • Build, coach, and retain a high-performing leadership team; create succession plans and ensure organizational resilience, including across multiple small, complementary brands as the portfolio grows.
  • Foster innovation by identifying disruptive trends (including AI), experimenting with new business models, and making data-driven bets that strengthen market position.
  • Champion a strong culture: set high performance standards, encourage collaboration, ensure alignment with saas.group values, and embed diversity and inclusion.
  • Be ready to take on additional brands within the same space as the portfolio grows

What you bring to the table

  • Proven leadership experience as a CEO, GM, or senior executive in a B2B SaaS HR Tech company, ideally product-led (PLG), with a strong track record of driving growth and building enduring businesses.
  • A strong operational and commercial background, first and foremost: you're an operator who has grown a product and a team
  • Marketing and product as core strengths: demonstrated ability to grow a SaaS product's user base and revenue through marketing-led and product-led motions.
  • Strong financial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, and P&L responsibility, with proven ability to link financial discipline to sustainable growth.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation through process improvements, operational standardization, and adoption of cutting-edge practices.
  • A talent magnet: skilled at hiring, developing, and retaining top performers, mentoring future leaders, and creating succession pipelines.
  • Strong people leadership: ability to set goals, hold teams accountable, address performance issues decisively, and nurture a culture of excellence.
  • Comfort managing more than one brand or business line at once, with the versatility to context-switch across a small portfolio of complementary products.
  • Fluent German speaker with strong English, given the initial market focus on Germany; international experience or ambition is a plus as these brands expand beyond DACH.
  • Visionary mindset with the ability to communicate a compelling long-term direction that inspires both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with fluency in English (additional languages are a plus).
  • AI Literacy & Application: You actively use AI tools to enhance personal productivity and work quality, staying curious about emerging capabilities and identifying opportunities to apply AI pragmatically in day-to-day work.

What's in it for you

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady and sustainable.
  • Small and friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning, and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Senior Director, Data, Pricing and Roaming

What You Will Be Doing

ChargePoint is seeking a Lead Product Manager, to lead our Fleet Vertical in Europe. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for solutions serving fleet operators and commercial vehicle customers across the European market. This is an individual contributor role in which you will operate as a subject matter expert and product leader, partnering closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver outcomes at scale.

The role spans hardware, software, and services — shaping the product portfolio across charging hardware, fleet-management software, and energy management solutions for the European fleet market.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for the Fleet segment in Europe — covering trucks, buses and vans — setting vision and making pricing, packaging, and launch decisions.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, sales, and operations to align on market opportunities, business priorities, and successful product introductions.
  • Drive the hardware portfolio (including truck charging solutions) and the software platforms as a unified product experience tailored to European fleet customer needs.
  • Identify and influence strategic partnerships — including relationships with truck and bus OEMs — and provide input on build, buy, or partner decisions.
  • Track market trends and competitive offerings; interface with customers and sales teams to ensure product direction and capabilities meet fleet market needs and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Communicate complex concepts in a structured way and drive alignment across a wide array of stakeholders, from engineering teams to executive leadership.

Requirements

  • 12 years of experience in fleet electrification, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, or adjacent mobility sectors.
  • Demonstrated track record in product management, business development, corporate strategy, or service/operational leadership roles.
  • Experience working with fleet operators, commercial vehicle customers, or energy management solutions preferred, truck charging experience is a plus.
  • Intellectually curious, analytical, creative, collaborative, user-centric, and a strategic thinker who can work effectively as an individual contributor in a matrixed organization.
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, structured narratives for diverse stakeholders.
  • Based in Europe; familiarity with the European EV regulatory environment and fleet market dynamics strongly preferred.

Location

Europe

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly.

ChargePoint is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes and supports all qualified individuals. In alignment with this commitment, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations throughout the employment process.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access any other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at accommodations@chargepoint.com.

ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer.
Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Subscriber Value
jobs.jd_full:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 remote-first employees (and growing!). For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI-native company where AI is integral to how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Growth organization drives Life360's subscription business, the engine that turns free usage into a paid membership and keeps that membership worth paying for, year after year. We set and evolve pricing and packaging for every Life360 membership, build features to increase the value of our subscriptions for users, manage the experimentation platform and the ML systems that personalize monetization, and own the partnerships that extend membership value. We are data-driven and focused on creating value for our subscribers by understanding their needs and wants. We are also an AI-native team: AI tooling is embedded directly into how we research, model, spec, and ship, and we expect everyone on the team to work that way.

About the Job

As Director of Product, Subscriber Value, you will be responsible for developing and executing a strategy to deliver value to our subscribers, while growing Life360’s subscriber base and subscription business.

You will develop new freemium features and improve existing ones, own the architecture and pricing of what members get for what they pay (tiers, entitlements, bundles, add-ons), and lead the portfolio of partner-powered value that complements the features we build ourselves. You will be accountable for the growth of our subscriptions and the satisfaction of members who choose to pay for one.

This is a director-level individual contributor role. You will set a strategy for one of Life360's highest-leverage surfaces, drive outcomes by working across engineering, design, analytics, ML, finance, and business development teams, and be the point person for advocating for subscriber value with the executive team and at every level of the company.

Life360 operates as an AI-native organization, and this role is expected to be a visible example of it. You will use AI throughout your workflow and help define what AI-native product management looks like on the monetization side of the business.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $201k to $294k USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $245k to $287k CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

  • Own the subscriber value strategy: define the membership portfolio architecture, including what belongs in each tier, what gets bundled, what gets unbundled, and what gets built versus partnered.
  • Drive the Subscriber Value roadmap and the development of freemium features that drive measurable value for our members.
  • Grow revenue per membership and set the framework that decides when to monetize incrementally versus deepening tier value.
  • Own premium services provided through 3rd parties, identify new opportunities and potential partners, hold partners to explicit launch and performance bars, and grow partner offerings over time to drive value for members and for the business.
  • Own pricing and packaging, including price architecture, promotional and discount strategy, and the execution of price changes across App Store, Google Play, and web billing, including building the business case and carrying it through executive approval.
  • Drive a culture of experimentation, from painted-door validation through fully-powered testing, leveraging AI and data science to provide value faster to our members.
  • Operate as an AI-native product leader: use AI to compress the path from question to decision to shipped experiment, build the reusable AI artifacts the rest of the team runs on, and help define the playbook for AI-native product management at Life360.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in consumer products, including 5+ years owning subscription monetization at scale, ideally in a business with millions of paying subscribers where you were accountable for revenue outcomes, not just feature delivery.
  • Demonstrable success in developing strategies that led to the growth of a subscription business, and in ideating and shipping features that drove measurable value for subscribers and increased their satisfaction.
  • Direct, hands-on ownership of pricing and packaging. You have shipped a price increase or a repackaging, and you can describe in detail what broke, what you did not anticipate, and what you would do differently.
  • A track record of product work enabled by commercial partnerships: you have scoped and launched revenue-share or embedded-partner integrations that increased the value of the product.
  • Deep fluency in mobile subscription mechanics, including App Store and Google Play architecture; proration and mid-cycle upgrade behavior; refund and cancellation differences across platforms; web billing; and the global regulatory landscape for subscription cancellation and disclosure.
  • Genuine unit economics fluency across lifetime value, gross margin, CAC, cohort retention curves, and contribution per member. You can build the model, stress-test someone else's, and identify opportunities for the business.
  • Strategic ownership at the Director level: you have set multi-quarter direction across a portfolio of surfaces rather than a single feature, made explicit prioritization calls under constrained capacity, and said no to good ideas with a defensible reason.
  • AI-native operator. This is a requirement, not a preference. Research synthesis, competitive teardowns, financial modeling, spec drafting, and reporting run with AI in the loop; you prototype with AI to validate ideas before spending engineering time; you are hands-on with current tooling; and you have used AI to deliver value in your products.
  • Deep empathy for families and comfort with the central tension of this role: Life360 is entrusted with families' safety, and every monetization decision either earns or erodes that trust.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use: You embed AI in all your workflows and use it for real, substantive tasks, including research, analysis, drafting, prototyping, analytics and experimentation.
  • Review and accountability for AI output: AI-generated outputs get the same level of care of as any of your deliverables. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity: We expect senior practitioners who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage: doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high-integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High-Intensity, High-Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds create a stronger, more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences creates a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications below, you should still seriously consider applying!

#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, eCommerce
jobs.jd_full:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff is building a new e-commerce advertising platform, and we're looking for a Product Manager to own it from zero to one. Today the product drives app users to purchase directly on merchants' e-commerce sites. You'll take the product from its current early state through beta and on the path to general availability, partnering with a dedicated engineering team, our ML organization, and go-to-market teams to set strategy, prioritize the roadmap, and decide what's in and out of scope. This is a senior, largely individual-contributor role with real autonomy: you'll own the business case, the experimentation roadmap, and the platform's identity and attribution architecture, and you'll represent Liftoff directly with customers and partners.

Responsibilities

Own the strategy and the business case

  • Set the product strategy, quarterly goals, and success metrics, and present progress against milestones to executive leadership and finance
  • Own the unit economics that define launch readiness (success metrics, traffic quality, funnel efficiency), and make the call on when the data supports scaling, pivoting, or stopping
  • Decide what stays out of scope. The possible surface area will always exceed team capacity, and disciplined scope-cutting is as important as anything you ship
  • Partner with GTM, sales, and account teams to define ideal customer profiles and go-to-market strategy, select and onboard customers, and turn customer intel into roadmap decisions. Represent Liftoff in customer conversations and strategic industry partnerships

Drive performance through ML partnership

  • Partner with Eng leads to own the experiment roadmap, interpret A/B results, and make Go/No-Go decisions
  • Diagnose full-funnel performance from ad impression through site session, add-to-cart, and purchase, and call out investigation opportunities
  • Set and enforce traffic quality and creative UX standards that protect advertiser outcomes, including suppression logic and inventory quality controls

Own identity, attribution, and platform integrations

  • Work with Legal to define product policy around consent handling, regional privacy requirements, customer data protection, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Develop strategic partnership and integration opportunities to ensure robust measurement and attribution
  • Defend our attribution methodology and incrementality story with sophisticated performance marketers and agencies
  • Lead e-commerce platform integration work end to end: pixels, server-side event delivery, order attribution, catalog ingestion, and merchant-facing installation flows

Requirements

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in performance advertising: DSP, retargeting platform, measurement/MMP, or ad network e-commerce products
  • Hands-on depth in web and mobile identity and attribution: probabilistic matching (IP and device signals), pixels, server-to-server postbacks, and the practical constraints of browser privacy changes (ITP, fingerprinting protection) and ATT
  • A track record of carrying a product from beta to GA, including at least one experience where you recommended killing or materially pivoting something based on the data
  • Comfort operating in a 0-to-1 incubation environment: small, funded pilots, hands-on customer management, and shipping against explicit go/no-go criteria
  • Demonstrated ML experimentation experience: you can read a confidence interval, challenge an experiment design, and make a ship/no-ship call under uncertainty
  • Cross-functional leadership across engineering, ML, go-to-market, sales engineering, creative, and finance without direct authority over any of them

Preferred / What Sets You Apart

  • Experience with the Shopify/e-commerce ecosystem: app approval, Customer Privacy API, webhooks, catalog/product feeds, or merchant-facing tooling. Familiarity with CAPI-style server-side integrations (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions) also counts
  • Familiarity with incrementality testing, MTA, or MMM, and the attribution debates (first-click vs. last-click, demand creation vs. demand capture) that agencies and DTC marketers actually have
  • Executive-level financial fluency: you can build and defend a unit economics case to a senior audience and hold your ground under scrutiny

Location:

The preferred location for this role is within the Pacific Time Zone; however, this role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City.

Travel Expectations:

We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:

Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.

The following are our base salary ranges for this role:

  • SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, Seattle, NYC: $230,000 - $280,000
  • Olympia, Austin, San Diego, Santa Barbara, Boston: $211,000- $257,000
  • All other cities and towns in our approved states: $198,000- $240,000

#LI-VM1

#LI-Remote

Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.

Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.

Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Provider Platform
jobs.jd_full:
Our mission: e liminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We’re building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

Reporting to the VP, Care Innovation, the Principal Product Manager, Provider Platform will define and build the next generation of Spring Health’s provider experience.

Please note that this is a hybrid role based in New York City or San Francisco, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week. Candidates must be based in the NYC or SF metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on-sites.

What you’ll do

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Spring Health’s provider platform
  • Develop a deep understanding of the needs of providers across different care-delivery, practice, and caseload models
  • Create a flexible provider experience that supports clinical care, practice management, referrals, scheduling, documentation, billing, and payments
  • Identify opportunities to simplify fragmented workflows and create a more cohesive experience across the provider journey
  • Lead the evolution of mature products and platform capabilities while maintaining reliability, provider trust, and continuity of care
  • Partner with provider operations, network, clinical, finance, and commercial leaders to connect product decisions to provider satisfaction, engagement, growth, and business performance
  • Lead cross-functional teams spanning design, engineering, data, operations, clinical, and go-to-market functions
  • Establish a thoughtful approach to product adoption and change management across a large, diverse provider network
  • Use provider research, behavioral data, competitive intelligence, and financial analysis to identify unmet needs and make clear investment tradeoffs
  • Define and measure success across provider retention, platform engagement, administrative efficiency, payment experience, caseload growth, and care continuity
  • Communicate product strategy, sequencing, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

What success looks like in this role

  • Achieve top-line business growth targets tied directly to Spring Health’s provider platform through a credible phased roadmap
  • Measurable, sustained improvement in provider retention, satisfaction, and engagement with core platform workflows
  • Increased adoption of platform capabilities that reduce provider administrative burden and support practice growth
  • A scalable platform foundation that enables future growth, innovation, and operational efficiency
  • Demonstrate executive cross-functional leadership that aligns product development, engineering execution, and commercial business objectives under a shared strategy
  • Senior stakeholders aligned around a clear strategy, explicit tradeoffs, and shared measures of success

What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex, strategically important platform products.

  • A proven track record of setting product strategy and delivering across zero-to-one development, platform evolution, or large-scale product transformation.

    • A proven track record of setting product strategy and delivering across platform evolution, large-scale product transformation, or zero-to-one development

  • Experience building products for professional users whose workflows, trust, and economic outcomes are critical to the business.

  • Strong commercial and financial judgment, with the ability to connect product decisions to customer value, retention, growth, and operational performance.

  • Technical fluency and experience partnering closely with engineering on platform architecture, integrations, data models, and sequencing decisions.

  • A rigorous approach to discovery and measurement that combines qualitative research, behavioral data, competitive intelligence, and financial analysis.

  • Demonstrated success leading through ambiguity, making difficult tradeoffs, and driving execution across multiple teams and functions.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with an ability to clearly articulate product strategy and tradeoffs to senior leadership.

  • Experience introducing significant product or workflow changes while maintaining user trust, platform reliability, and business continuity.

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, fintech, or another regulated and operationally complex industry is strongly preferred. Experience with clinician-facing products, insurance workflows, or revenue-cycle management is a meaningful advantage.

The target base salary range for this position is $214,000 - $245,000, and is part of a competitive total rewards package including equity and benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually using Radford Global Compensation Database at minimum to ensure competitive and fair pay.

Benefits provided by Spring Health:

Note: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria.

  • Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to One Medical accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We’re building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Position Description

PingWind is seeking a Program Manager III (PM) who will provide technical, analytical, and lifecycle support to the Maritime Electronic Warfare Systems Division (MEWSD) for critical U.S. Navy Electromagnetic Warfare (EW), Decoy, and Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program (SEWIP) systems. This role supports cradle-to-grave activities, including engineering, technology transition, installation, logistics, product support, test and evaluation, sustainment, maintenance, and repair. The PM III will integrate logistics, data science, reliability and maintainability engineering, and operations research to analyze and model complex systems, improve operational availability, and support data-driven decisions. This position directly contributes to optimizing warfighting capability, system readiness, reliability, and lifecycle performance while balancing mission requirements, performance, and cost.

jobs.title: Project Manager - AEC
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

CRB is a leading provider of sustainable Engineering, Architecture, Construction and Consulting solutions to the global life sciences and food and beverage industries. Our 1,200 employees provide best-in-class solutions that drive success and positive change for our clients, our people and our communities. CRB is a privately held company with a rich history of serving clients throughout the world, consistently striving for the highest standard of technical knowledge, creativity and execution.

Job Description

The Project Manager is responsible for the direction and performance of consulting, design or construction management services for assigned project(s) of a nature greater in scope, valuation and complexity and with larger teams than those generally managed by the Project Manager. Responsible for client relationship management, including creating a positive experience that will lead to future work. Projects often include several subcontracts and may include several aspects of an integrated ONEsolution delivery methodology.

Location: Kansas City, MO - Hybrid work mode, three days in office

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage multidisciplinary design projects, coordinating architectural and engineering teams through all phases of design delivery
  • Develop and manage project work plans, schedules, and budgets to support high-quality, on-time, and on-budget design execution
  • Serve as the primary client contact during the design phase, fostering trusted relationships and ensuring a positive client experience
  • Facilitate clear communication and collaboration across internal teams, consultants, and stakeholders
  • Monitor project progress, risks, and changes; proactively identify and address scope, schedule, or budget impacts
  • Ensure adherence to CRB’s design standards, quality procedures, and project controls
  • Support project staffing needs in coordination with discipline leaders
  • Track and report project performance metrics, including financials, schedule adherence, and client satisfaction
  • Contribute to business development efforts by supporting client relationships and identifying opportunities for follow-on work

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant project management experience, preferably within an architecture or engineering design firm
  • Demonstrated experience managing design projects or serving as a Project Manager or Assistant Project Manager on complex, multidisciplinary teams
  • Experience in Life Sciences, Food & Beverage, AEC, Pharma, Advanced Manufacturing, related field, preferred

Additional Qualifications

  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach with the ability to lead and influence diverse design teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced design environment
  • Foundational understanding of architectural and engineering disciplines and the design project lifecycle
  • Professional certification (e.g., PMP, AECPM™) is preferred or willingness to obtain

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

CRB is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and it is our policy to provide equal opportunity to all people without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected category. Employment is contingent on background screening.
